extraction.Name: Will Barker
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record in Pawnee County, Okla., by allottee
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to G. E. Vandervoort, Sr. and Shap Thornton, for $2000 but both paid off when land sold; 80 acres sold to Jim Walker of Pawnee, for $2000 and 80 acres to Henry Collins, of Pawnee for $1500
extraction.Buyer: 80 acres sold to Jim Walker of Pawnee for $2000; 80 acres to Henry Collins of Pawnee for $1500, which was a fair price for the land
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The allottee feels that the mistake was made in issuing him a patent, which necessitated a sale of the land to pay off loans on the land, interest and taxes; Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income from any other source. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Patent receipted yes; date and manner of delivery of patent Oct. 28, 1928; mortgage not foreclosed, date of redemption not expired; mortgage released when land sold; no other property or money accumulated; wife and five minor children dependent upon him; good health; document notarized December 3, 1928, State of Oklahoma, County of Pawnee; Notary commission expires Jan. 31, 1929
